CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Football: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Football.
   B. Practise Football with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Football.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Football.

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The ticket price
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the volume

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Remove the need for rules

4. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

5. Best practice when working on Puppetry: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Puppetry.
   B. Damage equipment used for Puppetry.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Puppetry.
   D. Practise Puppetry with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Painting and Mosaic.
   B. Practise Painting and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Mosaic.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Mosaic.

7. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

8. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

9. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   C. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.

10. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   C. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.

11. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rounders.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.
   D. Practise Rounders with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   B. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Painting and Mosaic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Rounders and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Athletics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
